title: 第2391章 吓一吓她第2390章 都愧疚呢
slug: 皇叔借点功德王妃把符画猛了
lines: 周时阅知道了葬魂地，抱紧陆昭菱，看了看她的脸，又看向殷长行。
“那依师父看，此处葬魂地，是善行还是恶行？”他问，“小菱儿要怎么样才能够醒过来？”
殷长行沉吟片刻，“八千道符，能量太大，将此处封镇得极为严实，我猜测，那八千道符不仅是有封镇作用，还有安魂之用。既然是陆铭出手，他又是寻着葬魂地来的，那原先此处应该是恶行。”
后面一个问题，他还在想。小菱儿要怎么样才能醒过来？
“听白渊所说，当年陆铭像是冲着这葬魂地而来的，若是这个葬魂地是善行，等时间一到，葬下的这些魂都会化为天地灵气融于此方山脉，他又何必跑这一趟？”
殷长行这么一说，大家都觉得很有道理。
“这么说来，大师她爹也是个好人，就是为了来解决别人弄的这邪门葬魂地的。”盛三娘子眼睛微微发亮，“而且还能在这里现画八千道符！好厉害啊！真希望我当时就在旁边看着。”
看着大师她父亲坐在这里刷刷刷，刷刷刷地画八千道符，那场面得多壮观好看啊。
殷云庭几人却是在想着，能够独自画八千道符，陆铭的修为是得多高啊！而且，不累吗？不耗神吗？
他们以前本来就一直在猜测着陆铭的修为很高，但这一次是很具体地知道到底是有多强悍了。
“总算知道大师画符这么快到底是怎么来的了，就是随她爹。”盛三娘子叹了一句，佩服，实在是佩服。
他们这么多人突然都很想见到陆铭了，真不知道那到底是个什么样的人物。
这里见过陆铭的，反倒是千定星。
千定星回想着当初在鬼市见到的那男子，莫名也有些惆怅的怀念。
那人风姿，当真让人难忘。
不过，他见到的是那人三十来岁的时候，现在这白渊，说的应该是少年时期的他吧？
嘶，这么说，少年时期就那般厉害？
“所以，阿菱这到底能不能醒过来？”周时阅虽然也感叹陆铭的厉害，但那个跟他关系不大，他现在就想让陆昭菱醒过来！“师父，我能做些什么？”
要不是陆昭菱的脸色一直还有些红润，气息也挺平稳的，他又要往那什么生死劫去想了。
殷长行刚才就一直在想办法。
“我有个推测，那八千道符对于葬魂地来说是封镇净化，对小菱儿来说可能就是安魂安神。”
“所以，她才会睡得这般沉。要是想让她醒过来，兴许得剑走偏锋，想一个不太正经的办法。”
众人都看着他。
“只是会有一点儿风险。”殷长行说，“就是让她受一受惊吓，打破她的安神安魂，让她紧张惊惧，这样她自己会拼命让自己醒过来。”
“这怎么做？”周时阅皱了皱眉。
听着这个办法，他多少是有些心疼的。这等于是要吓陆昭菱？
“若是要用这个办法，就得把握好一个度，能够惊动她，但又不能真的惊吓到她。现在她是在睡得极沉的时候，防御也低，要是惊吓过度，怕把她吓出个好歹来。”
要怎么有分寸地“吓”一下陆昭菱？
大家都努力地想起来。
“王爷，要不然，先吃早饭？大家都精神了才能好好想办法。”青林低声说了一句。
周时阅这个时候哪里吃得下。
content_en:
Zhou Shiyue learned about the burial place, hugged Lu Zhaoling tightly, looked at her face, and then looked at Yin Changxing.
"In Master's opinion, is this place where souls are buried a good deed or an evil deed?" He asked, "How can Xiao Ling'er wake up?"
Yin Changxing pondered for a moment, "The eight thousand talismans have too much energy, and the place is sealed extremely tightly. I guess that the eight thousand talismans not only have the function of sealing off the town, but also have the function of requieming souls. Since it was Lu Ming who took action, and he came here looking for the burial place of souls, then he must have done evil here."
He was still thinking about the next question. How can Xiao Ling'er wake up?
"From what Bai Yuan said, Lu Ming seemed to have come here for this soul burial place. If this soul burial place was a good deed, when the time comes, the buried souls will turn into the spiritual energy of heaven and earth and merge with this mountain range. Why would he have to make this trip?"
When Yin Changxing said this, everyone thought it made sense.
"So, Master, her father is also a good person. He came here to solve this evil soul burial ground created by others." Mrs. Sheng's eyes shone slightly, "And she can draw eight thousand talismans here! It's so amazing! I really wish I was watching from the side."
Seeing the master and her father sitting here painting eight thousand talismans, the scene is so spectacular and beautiful.
Yin Yunting and others were thinking about how high Lu Ming's cultivation level must be if he could draw eight thousand talismans by himself! Besides, aren't you tired? Doesn’t it cost you God?
They had always guessed that Lu Ming's cultivation level was very high before, but this time they knew exactly how powerful he was.
"I finally know how the master drew the talisman so quickly. He just followed his father." Mrs. Sheng Sanni sighed, admiring her, she really admired her.
So many of them suddenly wanted to see Lu Ming. They really didn't know what kind of person he was.
The person who had seen Lu Ming here was Qian Dingxing.
Qian Dingxing recalled the man he met in the ghost market with an inexplicable feeling of melancholy.
That man's grace is truly unforgettable.
However, the person he saw was when he was in his thirties. This Bai Yuan should be talking about him as a teenager, right?
Hiss, so you were so powerful when you were a teenager?
"So, can Ah Ling wake up now?" Although Zhou Shiyue also lamented how powerful Lu Ming was, that had little to do with him. He wanted Lu Zhaoling to wake up now! "Master, what can I do?"
If Lu Zhaoling's face was still a little rosy and his breathing was quite stable, he would have to think about the calamity of life and death again.
Yin Changxing had been thinking of a way just now.
"I have a guess. For the soul burial place, those eight thousand talismans are for sealing off the town and purifying it, and for Xiao Ling'er, it may be to calm the soul and calm the mind."
"That's why she sleeps so deeply. If you want her to wake up, you may have to take a different approach and think of a less serious method."
Everyone looked at him.
"It's just a little risky," Yin Changxing said. "It means to frighten her, break her peace of mind, make her nervous and frightened, so that she will try her best to wake up."
"How to do this?" Zhou Shiyue frowned.
Hearing this method, he felt somewhat distressed. Is this tantamount to scaring Lu Zhaoling?
"If you want to use this method, you have to control the degree so that it can startle her, but not really scare her. Now she is in a very deep sleep, and her defense is low. If she is overly frightened, she may be scared out of her mind."
How to "scare" Lu Zhaoling appropriately?
Everyone tried hard to remember.
"Your Majesty, why don't you have breakfast first? Only when everyone is refreshed can we think of a solution." Qinglin whispered.
Where can Zhou Shiyue eat at this time?
